author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam builds an architectural model of his friends' new house as a housewarming present! And while Adam has previously built many architectural models using foamcore and hot glue, this is the first he's attempting to make out of wood, milling out the layout of the floors using the house's blueprint. 

Foamcore architectural model build: https://youtu.be/NNNcGCZHvxE

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
